description: AGSC-01-05: index.md MAY exist in any folder (OKF reserved), and a reader MUST NOT read an index.md, a README.md or an _index.md in a folder under content/ as an item; it reports each one it skips as the warning AGSC-E506. Derivation over the minimal fixture, whose lint reports nothing, plus one file content/concepts/index.md holding a title and a sentence and no type, kind or prov: read as an item it would fail lint with AGSC-E202 (no type), AGSC-E205 (the type does not match the folder) and AGSC-E501 (no prov). Skipped as a folder note, it yields exactly one finding, the AGSC-E506 warning naming that file, and lint exits 0. The Bundle root content/index.md is not such a file: it is read as the root document (AGSC-01-04).

add_files.content/concepts/index.md:
---
title: Concepts
---

The concepts of this node, one file each.
